## 3. Academic Publications & Research Work



### Publications



#### 1. Q-ALU (Quant Asymmetric Leaky Unit)

*A market-psychology-aware activation function with downside risk protection for high-frequency quantitative trading and deep reinforcement learning.*



- **Abstract Summary:** Q-ALU is an activation function specifically designed for neural networks used in quantitative finance and high-frequency trading (HFT). It addresses asymmetry in market dynamics where losses impact agent/trader utility more severely than gains (Prospect Theory). By introducing parameterized asymmetric slopes and dynamic scaling based on market volatility/drawdown, Q-ALU enhances feature representation during high-volatility regimes and deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agent training (e.g., PPO).

- **Publication Venue:** Social Science Research Network (SSRN) Working Paper Series

- **SSRN Link:** https://ssrn.com/abstract=7365098

- **DOI:** https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7365098

- **Official Open-Source PyTorch Repository:** https://github.com/cyclocerine/qalu-pytorch

### AI & Quantitative Finance



1. **AI Algorithmic Hedge Fund Platform**

   - **Repository:** https://github.com/cyclocerine/HedgeFund

2. **Q-ALU PyTorch Module**

   - **Repository:** https://github.com/cyclocerine/qalu-pytorch

   - **Description:** The official production-ready PyTorch module implementation of the Q-ALU custom activation function. Includes benchmark scripts, loss curve visualizations, and performance tests against standard ReLU/LeakyReLU models in financial time-series predictions.



3. **Stock Price & Pattern Prediction System**

   - **Repository:** https://github.com/cyclocerine/Stock-Price-Prediction

### Systems, Web & Applications



4. **Hospital Management System**

   - **Repository:** https://github.com/cyclocerine/HospitalManagementSystem

   - **Description:** Full-stack enterprise web application built using Django. Manages medical records, patient check-ins, doctor schedules, billing, and operational workflows with robust access control.



5. **Sudoku Solver**

   - **Repository:** https://github.com/cyclocerine/Sudoku-Solver

   - **Description:** Optimized algorithmic solver for Sudoku puzzles utilizing constraint satisfaction and backtracking algorithms.



6. **FreeBSD Hardware Performance Monitor**

   - **Description:** Custom hardware monitoring setup. Reads real-time server telemetry (CPU load, memory allocation, network throughput) from a FreeBSD host and streams metrics to an SSD1306 OLED display powered by an ESP8266 microcontroller over local network protocols.



7. **Smart Aquaculture System (IoT)**
